title: Normalized comparison with a specified quotient Roos limit
statement: For the completed coefficient datum and an arbitrary K-flat realization M of K of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], assume K is intrinsically complete in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion]. For any specified quotient Roos limit L of [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-limit], there is an isomorphism e: K ≅ L.obj whose composition with each evaluation, model restriction comparison and inverse model reduction comparison is the derived scalar adjunction unit at K.

source.place: steps 2–3: Koszul comparison, arbitrary specified Roos limit, and unit normalization

proof.text: Obtain the normalized quotient Roos triangle on the explicit Koszul completion, without completeness.

Complete the identities at the two product vertices to a triangle morphism from that triangle to L. Levelwise invertibility makes its completion component invertible. Compose with the intrinsic completion unit, invertible by the completeness hypothesis; use the triangle morphism equation and the normalized evaluations.

theorem completedReconstructionUnitComparison {K : adicDatumDerived T d}
    (M : AdicDatumModel T d K) (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = d.ideal)
    (hcomplete : IsCompletedIntrinsicallyDerivedComplete T d r f hf
      M.complex M.realization)
    (L : CompletedSequentialDerivedLimit T d (adicDatumModelTower T d M)) :
    ∃ e : K ≅ L.obj, ∀ n : ℕ,
      e.hom ≫ (L.p ≫ Pi.π (fun a : ℕ ↦ (adicDatumModelTower T d M).obj (op a)) n ≫
        (adicDatumModelRestriction T d M n).hom ≫
        (adicDatumRestriction T (adicDatumProjection T d n)).map
          (adicDatumModelReductionIso T d M n).inv) =
        (adicDatumAdjunction T (adicDatumProjection T d n)).unit.app K
